posts.subject: [ENG] Forum update 15.10.2017
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community

The following changes were applied to the forum today:
- The default design of forum has been temporarily changed to the red version.
- As of now there are forum statistics as well some inventions, the achievements are distributed once per month to users
- From now you can play Hangman and compete for the number 1 spot in the best list.
